Name: T's Craftable Auto-Grabber
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[size=1]Similar mods seem to exist, but I created this one to allow for more detailed customization.[/size]

[size=1]Enables crafting of Auto-Grabber.[/size]
[size=1]You can customize recipe requirements and crafting materials using ModConfig settings.[/size]

[color=#ffff00][size=4]The default settings for recipe emails and crafting materials are as follows:[/size][/color]
[color=#00ffff][size=4]"Recipe Release Conditions"[/size][/color]
[size=1]・Farming Skill Level: 10[/size]
[size=1]・Marnie's friendship level (number of hearts): 8[/size]
[size=1][color=#00ffff]"Recipe Materials"[/color][/size]
[size=1]・Material 1 (Type): Hardwood[/size]
[size=1]・Material 1 (Quantity): 200[/size]
[size=1]・Material 2 (Type): Hey[/size]
[size=1]・Material 2 (Quantity): 999[/size]
[size=1]・Material 3 (Type): Iron Bar[/size]
[size=1]・Material 3 (Quantity): 20[/size]


[size=1]Currently, English and Japanese translation files are included.[/size]

[size=1]You can find other mods in a similar series here.[/size]
[size=1][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42408]T's Craftable Auto-Petter[/url][/size]
